english.note: Use this as the usual all-purpose term of endearment for a lover or child.
This is the all-purpose affectionate noun, used for a loved person and sometimes a cherished animal or thing.
Use 寶貝 as a familiar term of affection for a loved one.
Use this as a familiar term of affection for a sweetheart.
Use 寶貝 as an affectionate form of address for a loved one, rather than for actual sugar.

Use this for a person or thing regarded as especially precious or valued.
